objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-isovalent-shell-execution
objects.description: The following analytic detects the execution of a shell inside a container namespace within the Cisco Isovalent environment. It identifies this activity by monitoring process execution logs for the execution of a shell (sh or bash) inside a container namespace. This behavior is significant for a SOC as it could allow an attacker to gain shell access to the container, potentially leading to further compromise of the Kubernetes cluster.
